justification: Both surfaces carry highly schematic carved imagery including simplified human forms and circular disc-like motifs, but that is close to the universal minimum of shared iconography. A shows a flat scene of repeated crescent boats with crew-stroke rows, stick figures and a long line of cup-marks, whereas B is a single anthropomorphic figure in the round whose body bears isolated relief motifs (face, discs, belt-like bands) — no shared narrative scheme, arrangement or relationships.
